name: Liverpool Chamber of Commerce
what: The Employer Representative Body that leads the Liverpool City Region LSIP.
why_contact: The place to find the full LSIP and see what local employers say they need.

name: Liverpool City Region Combined Authority
what: The devolved authority funding Skills Bootcamps and adult skills across the six boroughs.
why_contact: See the funded training and apprenticeship routes the Combined Authority runs right now.

name: Be More
what: The Liverpool City Region's careers, apprenticeship and skills portal.
why_contact: Search live apprenticeships and training funded for people your age across the six boroughs.

name: Growth Platform
what: The Liverpool City Region's business growth company and Local Growth Hub.
why_contact: Good for understanding which sectors are hiring and how local businesses are growing.

name: Liverpool City Region Careers Hub
what: The Careers & Enterprise Company hub linking schools, colleges and employers across the region.
why_contact: Ask your school or college about employer visits and workplace experience through this hub.

name: University of Liverpool
what: A Russell Group university strong in life sciences, engineering and physics.
why_contact: Explore degrees linked to the region's biomanufacturing, health and engineering strengths.

name: Liverpool John Moores University
what: A large university with strong sport science, engineering and built environment courses.
why_contact: Check degrees and apprenticeships tied to construction, sport science and manufacturing.

name: Edge Hill University
what: A university leading the LSIP's SME AI diagnostic pilot alongside teaching and health courses.
why_contact: See how a local university is helping businesses learn to use AI responsibly.

name: The City of Liverpool College
what: A large further education college with strong construction, digital and creative provision.
why_contact: Compare Level 2-3 courses and apprenticeships close to Liverpool city centre.

name: Wirral Metropolitan College
what: A further education college serving Wirral with strong technical and construction provision.
why_contact: A good first stop if you live on the Wirral side of the city region.

name: Hugh Baird College
what: A further education college in Sefton with health, care and creative strengths.
why_contact: Worth checking if you're based around Bootle, Sefton or south Liverpool.

name: Construction Industry Training Board (CITB)
what: The construction sector's skills body, named in the LSIP for electrotechnical and trades training.
why_contact: Find out which construction trades and qualifications are most in demand right now.
